Package bunshin

Interface Summary
Bunshin This interface is exported by all instances of Bunshin DHT.
RemoteListener Interface for subscribing to remote events
 

Class Summary
BunshinConnection This class wraps a connection to Bunshin substrate and is used by the application as its main DHT substrate.
BunshinImpl The provided implementation of Bunshin DHT.
BunshinSearch This class provides an extended methods of the DHT layer, making an owner keyword-search engine over Bunshin layer.
Context This interface represents a naming context, which consists of a set of name-to-object bindings These constants will be used for connecting to different DHT services.
